scheme_name: Vikaas-Day Care Scheme For Person with Disability Children
other_conditions: Beneficiary must have a disability covered under the National Trust Act (Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation, or Multiple Disabilities).
Beneficiary must not be simultaneously enrolled in the Samarth or Gharaunda schemes.
benefits_summary: Provides day‑care facilities, skill development, counseling and optional transport support for children with disability aged 10 and above.
